title: Life Admin & Paperwork Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=passport:status) OR (index=personal sourcetype=warranty:registration)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="passport:status","primary",sourcetype="warranty:registration","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from passport:status and warranty:registration to see whether two life admin feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `passport:status` and `warranty:registration` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main life admin data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
